name: dental-mirage
description: Monorepo de Dental Mirage. apps/web (Next.js) y packages/* son workspaces pnpm (ver pnpm-workspace.yaml); apps/api es un módulo Go independiente (ver docs/implementation-plan.md).

scripts.test:coverage:api: cd apps/api && go test ./internal/... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic && go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
